cells.quote: With regards to the performance-tracked virtual simulation exercises using Versius Trainer (Step 3), trainees required a median of 4.5 days (IQR 2) to complete all components of the training programme.
cells.note: Single-arm pilot; the text reports completion time but no comparison condition.

O.outcome_detail: trainee console-surgeon operations and training safety

result.effect: 43 operations; no adverse events related to trainees

cells.quote: Trainees participated in 43 operations as console surgeons which included right hemicolectomy, anterior resection, abdominoperineal excision, loop colostomy and cholecystectomy. No adverse events related to the trainee were reported in the training cases.
cells.note: Single-arm service evaluation with consultant supervision; no control or comparison group was reported.

O.outcome_detail: number of attempts to pass all simulation tasks

result.effect: p=0.02 overall; ST4 significantly better than ST7 and ST8, p<0.05

cells.quote: There was a significant variance between the STs in the number of attempts to pass all the tasks (p = 0.02), with the ST4 trainee performing significantly better than the ST7 and ST8 trainees (p < 0.05).
cells.note: This is a comparison of trainees within the pilot, not a randomized instructional comparison.

D.treatment: structured first-assist and basic-skills courses with feedback

result.effect: median score 5 (IQR 0.75) for all questionnaire sections

cells.quote: Feedback on the programme was positive with a median score of 5 (IQR 0.75) for all sections of the questionnaire.
cells.note: Descriptive post-course feedback only; no comparison condition or baseline was reported.
